description: Render nodes of a Figma file to image URLs in a format and scale.

file_key.description: Figma file key identifying the file containing the nodes to render.

format.description: Optional output format for the rendered images, such as png, jpg, svg, or pdf.

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to render as images.

scale.description: Optional scale factor for the rendered images.

name: get_images
